scope: Node24source API. Source imports separate; first render after imports.96sequential fresh processes with alternating order, four/arm/cache/case. Four same-source repeats, one edit, one edited repeat after first call. Sampling and timed observers off; full SVG+entire receipt serialized. ExplicitGC/compression/artifact writes outside timed calls. PeakRSS includes source import/harness/compression and retained first product; not package/browser memory. No representative-workload aggregate speedup.
